title: PistaLibre · book a court and play matches at your level
meta_desc: The padel clubs of Madrid in one app: book a court, join open matches at your level, send the result and climb the ranking. An example made with Neblla.
hero_h1: Play padel with people at your level
hero_p: The clubs of Madrid in one app. Book a court, join an open match and climb the ranking.
notice_html: This is an example made with Neblla: the clubs and the players are made up. Log in, book and play as if it were real. Each player pays for their spot to the club when booking; payments are test payments (card 4242 4242 4242 4242) and nothing is charged.
apply_cta_p: Sign up and your courts will show up here. We review it and let you know.
book_hint: Pick a day and time. When you book, you open a match for 4: other players at your level see it and join. Everyone pays for their own spot when booking, and the money goes to the club.
open_hint: Matches looking for players. You only see the ones at your level.
played_hint: After playing, each player says who won. If you all agree, it counts for the ranking.
premium_li1: You see open matches before anyone else: their first 12 hours are for Premium only
premium_li2: You support an app made for players
premium_note: Test payments: card 4242 4242 4242 4242, nothing is charged.
notices_hint: The club reminds you of your match the day before and writes to you here.
apply_hint: Tell us about your club. We review it and, if all is well, your club appears in PistaLibre and you manage its courts and bookings from your panel.
